Title: Azure Managed Cache Service and Azure In-Role Cache to be retired November 30, 2016

Body.Content: This is a follow-up reminder to our announcement last year regarding the retirement plan. Azure Managed Cache Service and the Azure In-Role Cache service will remain available for existing customers until November 30, 2016. After this date, Managed Cache Service will be shut down, and the In-Role Cache service will no longer be supported. We’ll remove support for creating new in-role caches in the first Azure SDK release that happens after February 1, 2016. Customers will be able to open existing projects that have in-role caches.
